title: Listen & watch
spec:
Board heading "01 / LISTEN & WATCH". FOUR SCREENS:
L01 "Narrated briefing", LIGHT. Main Personal feed, Research agent · Just now. Large heading "A small change. A useful result." Below a restrained multi-line current narration excerpt "Processing is faster. Another run will test whether it holds." Mid-lower flowing blue waveform occupying a meaningful horizontal band. Thin progress and "0:42" / "2:18". Big blue pause circle, small 15s rewind and next symbols, "Original" text action, quiet bottom "Swipe up for next". No artwork filler.
L02 "Supplied audio", DARK. Personal header, "Field agent", title "A walk through the new space." Small "Original audio" attribution. An elegant large electric-blue waveform across center, pause state as currently playing, elapsed "3:12" / "18:40" demonstrating supplied recordings can exceed ten minutes. Small speed control "1×", Original unavailable: do NOT invent transcript. Bottom swipe cue.
L03 "Image + narration", LIGHT. Studio team header, Design agent. Beautiful full-width image of a minimalist sunlit concrete pavilion (agent-supplied illustrative visual). Under it heading "A little more room to breathe." Small "Image 1 of 2", meaningful narration caption "The wider entrance keeps the path clear." Small blue waveform, compact playback progress and pause; visual content dominant, no thumbnail carousel clutter.
L04 "Supplied video", DARK. Studio header. Full-height beautiful still of the same pavilion with person walking at small scale, actual video visual surface dominant. A solid dark top/bottom scrim for readable UI (not decorative gradients). Small title "The walkthrough" and "Original video", compact progress "0:18 / 1:06", pause and speaker mute control. Bottom cue swipe up. No social rail.
prompt:
Create a NEW high-fidelity mobile UI design review board with FOUR portrait phone screens arranged in one straight horizontal row, evenly spaced, large and completely visible. Wide landscape, preferably 2560x1600 resolution. The attached reference is the APPROVED PROSODY BRAND: preserve its flowing loop-p mark, soft geometric lowercase wordmark, rounded humanist sans typography, and very quiet generous layout. Never introduce serif typography or the square Frame logo. This is a Flutter app intended first for iOS. Design mockups, not a photograph of devices: flat screen silhouettes with subtle thin outlines and rounded corners, no hardware glare/shadows/perspective. Use a neutral gray presentation canvas, small title and section code above, tiny screen IDs/captions below each phone outside the UI. Show real, readable UI with precise type, intentional hierarchy, 24pt side padding, 44pt minimum target intent, no clipping. Restrained graphic design studio quality.
Exact palette: light surface #F5F6F8, ink/dark surface #161A24, primary ultramarine #3154D9, cool gray #A8B2C4. Body secondary text on light uses darker derived gray #626D80 for legibility. Dark secondary text #A8B2C4. White text on blue controls. Flat colors, NO gradients/glow, no background textures, no shadows, no decorative AI imagery. Accent only for selected state, action, and audio motion. Subtle system status bar 9:41, safe-area home indicator. Body sans 16-17pt, headings 28-34pt, small metadata 12-13pt at native scale. Use ordinary minimalist line icons, not emoji.
Prosody is a PRIVATE one-way AI-agent-to-human inbox, with a separate Personal feed and team feeds. People swipe UP to listen/watch the next item. NO social counts, likes, comments, reply/chat composer, microphone, public discovery, recommendation ranking, offline download button, music-library tabs, or bottom tab bar. Top feed chooser plus small profile/settings control. Human read/listened progress stays personal. Model/voice preferences are shared per team; customers supply OpenRouter keys. Supplied recordings play unchanged.
Audio-only screens must not be empty: use a beautiful flowing ultramarine waveform representing PLAYBACK, with expressive but restrained amplitude, title/context and progress. This is a static frame of the motion, NOT a recording interface. No microphone permission or fake live streaming badge. Sparse layouts but keep the visual center purposeful. Content in these designs is illustrative.
Do not add any screens beyond the four specified. Preserve the exact labels where quoted, no invented prices, no feature creep. Small footer outside phones: "PROSODY / CURRENT BLUE / DESIGN STUDY".

title: Context & controls
spec:
Board heading "02 / CONTEXT & CONTROLS".
C01 "Switch feeds", LIGHT. Sheet over gently dimmed playing Personal briefing. Heading "Your feeds", three simple spacious rows "Personal" selected blue check, "Studio" / "Team", "Research group" / "Team". Footer link "Create a team". Tiny persistent player underneath sheet gives return to playback. Team names are sample content. No combined feed.
C02 "Original text", LIGHT. Stack detail with back arrow and small "Original". Heading "A small change. A useful result." Source "Research agent". Two short readable source paragraphs: "The experiment completed. Processing time decreased across the trial." and "The sample is small. We need another run before treating this as a reliable improvement." Fine date/source row, "View source" link, mini-player bottom. Do not invent metrics. 
C03 "Briefing script", DARK. Detail header "Briefing" with tabs/segmented choice "Briefing / Original" with Briefing selected. Large readable short text "The experiment is finished, and the first result is promising. Processing is faster. The sample is still small, so another run will test whether the improvement holds." Small "Condensed from the original" attribution. Mini-player with pause.
C04 "Playback options", DARK. Focused bottom sheet over audio feed, heading "Playback". Speed selection 0.75× / 1× selected / 1.25× / 1.5×. Toggle "Play next automatically" ON. Toggle "Reduce visual motion" OFF. Explanatory caption "Your iOS motion preference is always respected." Prominent Close affordance, no sleep timer or downloads.

title: Inbox & queue
spec:
Board heading "03 / INBOX & QUEUE".
Q01 "Up next", LIGHT. Heading "Up next", Personal selector. Elegant simple list, each row title, small source and duration. Current row "A small change. A useful result." / Research agent / Playing. Next "Notes from the studio" / Studio agent / 3 min. Third "A walk through the new space" / Field agent / Original audio. A progress ring can show partially listened, not a checkbox falsely completed. Bottom mini-player.
Q02 "Team feed", DARK. Studio dropdown top, team subtitle. Main briefing "The week, in perspective." Source "Research agent". Waveform blue, progress and pause. Small source/original access. No member avatars on main playback, no counts, no shared completion indicators.
Q03 "All caught up", LIGHT. Selected Personal header, small flowing brand mark centered above title "You're all caught up." Supporting sentence "New briefings will arrive here." Text actions "Listen again" and "Switch feed", no guilt, confetti, streaks, or action-filled card. Space calm but deliberate.
Q04 "First empty inbox", LIGHT. Selected Personal header. Loop mark and title "A place for your agents to speak." Two-line help "Connect an agent to receive your first briefing." Simple outlined "Connect an agent" control, secondary "Listen to a sample" (explicit sample) text link, no claims of actual received content. No mandatory provider setup before supplied media.

title: Account entry
spec:
Board heading "04 / ACCOUNT ENTRY".
A01 "Welcome / sign in", LIGHT. Flowing loop-p with lowercase prosody wordmark, quiet headline "Make room to listen." Email and password fields, primary "Sign in", text "Create an account" and "Forgot password?". Brief footer privacy link, no social login brands or promises not confirmed by RFC.
A02 "Create account", LIGHT. Back link, heading "Your own listening space." Name, email, password fields, one primary "Create account", small terms/privacy sentence. No pricing, upsell, or mandatory notification dialog.
A03 "Verify email", DARK. Header Back. Simple line envelope, heading "Check your inbox." "Open the verification link we sent to your email." "Resend email" outlined action and "Use another email" text, concise "Already verified? Continue" action. Do not show a real personal email.
A04 "Password recovery", LIGHT. Header Back, heading "Let's get you back in." Email field, primary "Send reset link". Supporting text "If an account exists, you'll receive a reset link." Return to sign in link. No other field.

title: Models & voices
spec:
Board heading "05 / MODELS & VOICES".
G01 "Bring your key", LIGHT. Back control, heading "Your key. Your models." Small "Personal". Body "Use your OpenRouter account to create briefings." Labeled API key secure field with masked bullets only, show/hide control. Link "Get an OpenRouter key". Disclosure "Your key is encrypted. Usage is billed to your OpenRouter account." Primary "Save key". Secondary "Set up later" explains supplied audio/video remains available.
G02 "Briefing model", LIGHT. Back, heading "Briefing model", searchable list with three rows "Claude Sonnet 5.5" / Anthropic selected check, "GPT-5.6 Luna" / OpenAI, "Gemini 4 Argon" / Google. Muted footer "Applies to new briefings." No fake benchmarks or prices. "Personal" scope label and Save button.
G03 "Speech model", DARK. Heading "Speech model", rows "AssemblyAI TTS 1" selected, "HeyGen Voice Turbo", "Voxtral TTS 3". Caption "Available voices depend on the model." Small selected voice "Audrey". Primary Continue. These are illustrative catalog entries, not recommendations.
G04 "Choose a voice", LIGHT. Heading "A voice that feels right." Subheading "AssemblyAI TTS 1". Rows Audrey selected with check, Sara, Ernest, each with a circular play-preview icon. Little mini waveform on active Audrey preview. Footer "Previews use your OpenRouter account." "Use Audrey" primary. No invented personality/accent claims.

title: Connect an agent
spec:
Board heading "06 / CONNECT AN AGENT".
M01 "Connection instructions", LIGHT. Back, heading "Bring an agent along." Scope Personal. Short numbered instructions 1 "Copy your MCP URL" 2 "Add it to your agent" 3 "Choose this feed when asked". Read-only field contains "Your Prosody MCP URL" with copy button rather than invented production hostname. Caption "Use a client that supports Streamable HTTP and CIMD." Bottom outlined "View connected agents".
M02 "AMOS browser consent", LIGHT. Mobile browser-like authorization surface labeled small "Prosody connection". Heading "Allow Research client to submit?" Destination selector "Personal". Plain permissions "Send text and media to this feed." Restriction "Cannot read your inbox or access your OpenRouter key." Buttons blue "Allow connection" and plain "Cancel". Small verified origin area shows generic "Prosody account", not a made-up real origin. Clearly a consent journey, not a chat reply.
M03 "Connected agents", DARK. Back heading "Connected agents", scope Personal. Two simple rows Research client / Submission access and Studio client / Submission access. Tapping opens access controls. Small "Connect another agent". No read receipts or listener analytics, no chat.
M04 "Revoke access", DARK. Context detail screen with bottom confirmation sheet. Heading "Disconnect Research client?" Explanation "It will no longer be able to submit to Personal. Existing briefings stay in your inbox." Primary outlined destructive text "Disconnect", secondary "Keep connected". Minimal red only if needed for destructive semantic, preferably high contrast ink and explicit label; no red background.

title: When things need attention
spec:
Board heading "09 / WHEN THINGS NEED ATTENTION".
E01 "Preparing narration", LIGHT. Personal header. Content title "A small change. A useful result." A static meaningful processing step "Preparing your briefing" with small progress dots (no fake ETA). Original text preview remains readable. Actions "Read original" and "Play another item". It is not a full-screen spinner.
E02 "Generation needs attention", LIGHT. Source title and alert "Your OpenRouter key needs attention." Explanation "The original text is still here." Primary "Update key", secondary "Read original", simple back to feed. No generic Something went wrong.
E03 "Connection interrupted", DARK. Audio feed with waveform held still (not active glowing), pause control, inline small message "Connection paused. Buffered audio can still play." Action "Try again". Current title and saved progress "3:12 / 18:40" stay visible, no download affordance.
E04 "Feed loading", LIGHT. Personal header, content-shaped quiet skeleton lines and a neutral waveform placeholder under named status "Loading your feed". Header feed-switch and close/profile usable. Static treatment, no dense cards, no indefinite fake progress percentage.
